sanskrit_verse:
साक्षिदोषाः प्रयोक्तव्याः संसदि प्रतिवादिना ।
पत्रे विलिख्य तान् सर्वान् वाच्यं प्रत्युत्तरं ततः ॥
transliteration:
sākṣidoṣāḥ prayoktavyāḥ saṃsadi prativādinā |
patre vilikhya tān sarvān vācyaṃ pratyuttaraṃ tataḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: All evidentiary discrepancies must be presented by the respondent in council; these shall be recorded in writing and thereafter addressed through responsive declaration.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the collective discernment of conscious witnesses
Causation is established through documented contradiction, not accusation
Capacity-based responsibility requires full disclosure of perceptual conflict
Restoration logic demands transparency before rebuttal
Consciousness alignment occurs when all disputable evidence is openly inscribed
executable_legal_axioms: IF a dispute involves conflicting testimony THEN all discrepancies MUST be transcribed prior to rebuttal
IF a respondent raises an objection THEN it SHALL be documented IN WRITING before verbal response
IF any witness reports divergence in perception THEN that divergence MUST be formally recorded BEFORE proceeding
IF adjudication begins THEN all parties MUST acknowledge receipt of written discrepancies
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes the threshold requirement for evidentiary integrity: no oral contradiction may proceed without prior written documentation. The Court's authority is activated only upon receipt of fully disclosed perceptual conflicts.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality requires that contradiction be witnessed, recorded, and acknowledged. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential manifestation: first inscription, then response. Proportional responsibility aligns with capacity to perceive and disclose. Non-punitive reality is upheld as truth-disclosure becomes the sole mechanism of resolution.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: All contradictory observations must be fully transcribed
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Each party confirms awareness of documented discrepancies
Capacity Restoration: Parties are granted time and space to verify written records
Integrity Reintegration: Final acknowledgment of record completeness precedes judgment
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma is declared: Truth prevails through witnessed inscription, not punitive enforcement. Consciousness alone adjudicates, and reality remains non-punitive.
